text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki heard about the recovery 
progress of Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro 
Ardan. However, there was still no 
timetable for their return...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two voice their anxiety, wondering if 
anyone is still waiting for them. Yaeno 
Muteki vows to keep running to protect a 
place for them to belong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki and the Trainer watch the 
Arima Kinen. The crowd showered the 
victorious Oguri Cap with immense praise, 
calling her the true representative of 
their generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki was outraged that no one 
brought up their names. The true 
representatives of the generation were 
those who fought in the Classic Triple 
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, she would defeat Oguri Cap and prove 
that their generation carries the future. 
That was the "obsession" Yaeno Muteki 
displayed.
